caption:
Clinic ke liye 3 automations jo patients badhate hain, bina extra staff ke. 🦷🩺

1️⃣ Instant reply: raat 9 baje message aaye to bhi 5 sec mein WhatsApp reply + kal ke free slots + booking link
2️⃣ Appointment reminder: 1 din pehle + 2 ghante pehle, "reschedule" button ke saath. No-show kam.
3️⃣ Review request: visit ke 2 ghante baad "Kaisa laga?" + direct Google review link

Sab aapke apne WhatsApp Business pe, setup 3-5 din.

Save karo 🔖 aur clinic staff ko bhejo.

Comment "AUDIT" 👇 free 3-min video audit.
